newsitem.title: JAPAN: Toyota Motor sets year high after open.
newsitem.headline: Toyota Motor sets year high after open.

text.p: Shares in Toyota Motor Corp set a high for this year in early morning trade on Friday for the first time in three months, brokers said.
The shares rose briefly to a high of 2,820 yen, but were back down at 2,810 yen, the previous high set on June 25, by 0032 GMT. Toyota closed at 2,810 yen on Thursday.
The trade volume so far on Friday was 860,000 shares.
"It's easy to buy Toyota shares because its earnings are solid and the dollar is strengthening against the yen," an analyst at a medium-sized brokerage said.
However, some market sources said further gains were likely to be limited.
"The firm's profits are healthy partly because consumers are expected to buy cars before the consumption tax is raised in April," a fund manager at an investment trust said.
He added: "Toyota shares constitute the core of foreign and institutional investors (portfolios) so aggressive buying may not emerge if the share prices rise."
